_about: PC runner settings (B4100-B4109). train: this runner drives the merge train (B7202; one PC at a time: the New PC from 25 Nov, B8000-B8010, with the Main PC as its backup; the Main PC drove it from B7620, and the Secondary PC stood in while it was down, B7500); trainMinutes, trainMaxHours and sweepUpdates are optional. lanes: the testbed lanes the runner drives, never 1, and not 6 (kept for the local agents since 2026-11-16, B6527). light: jobs that need no lane (book and Trove lookups) run side by side up to this many. Folders use %NAME% from the environment. prGatesPreferPeer (B7911, Ben 24 Nov): pull request gate runs go to the New PC first; this runner takes one only when the New PC has no free lane, is holding, its status is older than freshMinutes, or the run has waited maxMinutes.
_sprites: B6144, B8100: Foundry user data folders whose worlds may ask for sprites from inside the game, and the Python with numpy and Pillow that runs tools/sprites/batch.py. Never lane 1 (the owner's own data) or the Live world, and no gate lane: gates make characters, and each would start a drawing. The solo world is on the New PC (runner.new_pc_lebrun.json).
